title: Verify a template that is both location auto-apply AND a customer default is added only once to a new work order
custom_preconds: 1. A template "ZZAUTOTEST Env Fee" is marked auto-apply at the location AND is a default on the test customer.
custom_steps:
1. Create a new work order for the customer.
  2. Open the 'WO Fees & Discounts' card and count how many copies of the shared template's fee/discount appear.
custom_expected:
1. Exactly one copy appears on the new work order.
  2. No second copy of the same template is added.
